related.title: TLS 1.3：握手轉錄與金鑰分離
related.titleEn: TLS 1.3: handshake transcripts and key separation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：80與60日交集重算正確，四案都按指定限制判定；可信根的選擇有獨立來源。 交付鏈結圖、四案驗證表與有效期交集時間線。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 80 and 60 days, correctly evaluate all four cases and document an independent source for anchor trust. Deliver the chain diagram, four validation fixtures and the validity-intersection timeline.
related.difference: 以虛構ClientHello、ServerHello、Certificate、CertificateVerify及Finished畫時序；區分握手金鑰與應用金鑰，標明transcript涵蓋訊息。
related.differenceEn: Draw a fictional ClientHello, ServerHello, Certificate, CertificateVerify and Finished sequence; distinguish handshake/application keys and transcript coverage.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學時間交集取max(notBefore)到min(notAfter)，但名稱、用途、簽章與可信錨仍須獨立通過。 葉憑證有效日10至90，簽發CA有效日0至100；信任錨已由另一步驗證，本題採半開區間。 交集長度min(90,100)−max(10,0)=80日；葉憑證終日改70時為60日。
本題簡化握手延遲=一個網路RTT+兩端合計計算時間；不含DNS、TCP建連與應用回應，不能當網頁總延遲。 合成鏈路RTT40毫秒，端點計算合計8毫秒；無HelloRetryRequest或封包遺失。 40+8=48毫秒；RTT改80毫秒、計算不變時為88毫秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The teaching validity intersection runs from max(notBefore) to min(notAfter); names, purpose, signatures and trust anchors still require separate checks. Leaf validity is days 10–90 and issuing-CA validity 0–100; the trust anchor is established separately and intervals are half-open for this exercise. Intersection length is min(90,100)−max(10,0)=80 days; changing leaf end to 70 gives 60 days.

Simplified handshake latency is one network RTT plus combined endpoint computation; it excludes DNS, TCP setup and application response and is not total page latency. A synthetic link has RTT 40 ms and combined computation 8 ms, with no HelloRetryRequest or loss. 40+8=48 ms; RTT 80 ms with unchanged computation gives 88 ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: nftables：分區政策、連線狀態與原子更新
related.titleEn: nftables: segmentation, connection state and atomic updates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：80與60日交集重算正確，四案都按指定限制判定；可信根的選擇有獨立來源。 交付鏈結圖、四案驗證表與有效期交集時間線。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 80 and 60 days, correctly evaluate all four cases and document an independent source for anchor trust. Deliver the chain diagram, four validation fixtures and the validity-intersection timeline.
related.difference: 為管理、教學、資料與訪客四區畫流向圖；每個有向跨區組合測HTTPS與管理服務，另列既有連線回程規則。
related.differenceEn: Map management, teaching, data and guest zones; test HTTPS and management service for every directed interzone pair and separately define established-return behavior.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學時間交集取max(notBefore)到min(notAfter)，但名稱、用途、簽章與可信錨仍須獨立通過。 葉憑證有效日10至90，簽發CA有效日0至100；信任錨已由另一步驗證，本題採半開區間。 交集長度min(90,100)−max(10,0)=80日；葉憑證終日改70時為60日。
不含自連的有向區間測試數=Z(Z−1)S；連線回程必須依狀態解釋，不能把反向新連線與回應封包混為一談。 Z=4區、S=2類服務；本題只數新連線政策組合。 4×3×2=24案；新增一個設備區後5×4×2=40案。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The teaching validity intersection runs from max(notBefore) to min(notAfter); names, purpose, signatures and trust anchors still require separate checks. Leaf validity is days 10–90 and issuing-CA validity 0–100; the trust anchor is established separately and intervals are half-open for this exercise. Intersection length is min(90,100)−max(10,0)=80 days; changing leaf end to 70 gives 60 days.

Directed interzone test count excluding self-links is Z(Z−1)S; interpret return traffic by state rather than equating replies with reverse new connections. Z=4 zones and S=2 service classes; count only new-connection policy combinations. 4×3×2=24 cases; adding a device zone gives 5×4×2=40.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
